hero.title: About Shri Nathuram Maharaj Mahavidyalaya
hero.description: Providing quality education with a focus on Civil Services and Kirtan Shastra.

overview.introduction: Gramin Yuvak Pratishthan is an organization established by the secretary of the institution, Prof. Dr. Balaji Munde, in 2004. For the past 21 years, the organization has been working to empower the youth and women in rural areas through education and training. Gramin Yuvak Pratishthan established Shri Nathuram Maharaj College at Kehal in Jintur Taluka of Parbhani district. Establishment of the college is a further step of rural empowerment mission of the Gramin Yuvak Pratishthan. The college's journey is moving forward based on the President Mrs. Lalita Nagargoje & secretary Dr Balaji Munde’s experience in social work and education. Organization is also running another primary school at Parli Vaijnath in Beed district named Oxford Brilliants School.
overview.history: Dedicated to providing excellent academic programs in the heart of Parbhani district.
